subject: Request: pilot extension + blended credits and pricing carveout — QuillForge
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@quillforge.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Nov 2028 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot: scope + ask for extended runway and credits

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency profile and the prefix caching examples. We ran the first synthetic load against Redwood and got results that look promising for our embedded vector use case.

We have a stakeholder ask before we commit to a year: can you extend the pilot window by 60 days and provide a credits package that covers our projected usage during that time? Concretely: we expect ~1.2B tokens over the extended 60-day ramp and would need a credits bridge plus a short-term pricing carveout to match our procurement cadence. Without the runway and some commercial flexibility we won't be able to get legal and security sign-off in time.

Attached: Pilot SOW v1.pdf (attachment, 98KB)

High level asks:
- Pilot extension from 30 -> 90 days
- $60k in free credits applied to pilot consumption
- Short-term pricing carveout: 25% off list for the first 3 months if we convert to a committed plan within 30 days after the pilot

Happy to jump on a quick call today to walk through numbers.

Best,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of ML Platforms, QuillForge
samir.patel@quillforge.ai
+1 415-555-0127
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@quillforge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Nov 2028 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: scope + ask for extended runway and credits

Samir — thanks for laying this out. I appreciate the clarity on usage and the target conversion timing. I copied Marissa and Aditya for rapid authorization; I want to propose a concrete mutual action plan so we can get procurement and legal moving:

Proposed concession (internal ask to leadership):
- Pilot extension: 90 days total (60 day extension)
- Credits: $60,000 in platform credits applied to pilot consumption (applies to hosted inference only)
- Pricing carveout: 25% off list for the first 90 days post-conversion if QuillForge signs a 12-month committed plan within 30 days of pilot close
- Contingency: if QuillForge doesn't convert within 45 days of pilot close, credits are forfeited (to avoid open-ended deferrals)

If leadership greenlights this, I will have Legal draft a short amendment to the SOW and Procurement can route a limited-time PO path. Can Marissa/Aditya confirm risk tolerance for the credits + the carveout? I'll also ask Marcus to confirm accounting treatment for the credits (deferred revenue/contra-revenue).

Attaching a simple mutual action plan spreadsheet for internal review: QuillForge-MAP.xlsx (attachment, 12KB)

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 5 Nov 2028 11:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: scope + ask for extended runway and credits

Thanks Mina — quick questions before I escalate to Finance and Legal for a formal memo:

1) Expected ARR/probability if QuillForge converts after pilot (help me justify the credit).
2) Are there any IP or data residency concerns we need to route to Security?
3) Any precedent in the last 12 months for combined credit + carveout for pilot-stage startups?

Quick context: I am comfortable with a limited credit bridge for a high-probability conversion (>60%) that can be operationalized with a PO or pre-signed amendment. Marcus — can you advise on the accounting treatment and whether a $60k credit can be handled as a marketing/activation rebate vs. direct revenue credit?

If Marcus and Aditya are okay, I will prepare an approval memo to present to Ops leadership for a one-off exception. We should keep the SOW language tight on timeboxes and conversion triggers.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 7 Nov 2028 09:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot: scope + ask for extended runway and credits

Marissa/Aditya/Marcus — forwarding Samir's original ask with updated conversion notes below. Per Samir on the call:
- High likelihood to convert at >70% if pilot demonstrates 95th percentile latency below 350ms on their 4-token hot path
- Procurement timeline: legal needs 45 days for a standard PO and 14 days for security attestation; hence the runway request

I confirmed with Product that we can reserve a dedicated test pool for the 90-day pilot and enable prefix caching as configured in their test harness. From a legal standpoint, they asked us to include a capped indemnity schedule and a data retention window of 90 days — nothing unusual, but Legal will need to review.

Please see inline responses to Marissa's questions:
1) ARR: QuillForge forecasted $420k ARR in year-1 if converted to committed plan (sales estimate).
2) Security: no unusual data residency asks; they will use tokenization and ephemeral logs. Security team has a short-assessment form ready.
3) Precedent: We did a combined credit + conversion discount for two accounts in Q2; both converted within 60 days.

If we get an approval memo, I will send the amendment to Samir and loop Procurement so they can prepare PO language.

Onward —
Mina
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@quillforge.ai>, Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@quillforge.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Nov 2028 16:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: scope + ask for extended runway and credits — APPROVED

Team / Samir — after reviewing the numbers and precedent, I am authorizing a one-time commercial exception for QuillForge with the following guardrails: 

Approved concession (final):
- Pilot extension to 90 days total (effective immediately)
- $60,000 platform credit applied to hosted inference consumption during the pilot period
- Post-pilot pricing carveout: 25% off list for the first 90 days post-conversion, contingent on QuillForge signing a 12-month committed plan within 30 days of pilot close
- Credits are forfeited if conversion does not occur within 45 days of pilot close

Operational items:
- Legal to prepare an SOW amendment and limited indemnity language (Mina to coordinate)
- Marcus/Finance: please confirm accounting entries; treat credits as contra-revenue per policy and document in the approval memo (attachment).
- Samir: please sign the DocuSign amendment within 72 hours of receipt. DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/sign/QF-9341

I've uploaded a short approval memo: approval-memo.pdf (attachment, 6KB). Marcus — please add the memo to the deal record (HS-0009341).

Congrats team — this is the right balance of commercial support and guardrails.

—Aditya
